description: Functional specification: shared Docker browser-runtime selects Rust/CDP backend for Cargo-only install; add bounded CI smoke transport script covering raw Chromium launch, explicit default backend comparison, inherited native backend open/url/close in unique sessions. Tests before implementation: shell transport contract tests success, backend mismatch, browser failure, URL mismatch and cleanup; real image acceptance only in Docker CI (docker unavailable locally). Paths: Dockerfile, test/support/bin/browser-runtime-smoke, test/support/browser_runtime_smoke_test.exs. Mock only external docker command in contract tests, never browser integration.
